allowed_operation: Read Parquet schema/footer metadata only. Do not execute any row-returning query.

primary_interaction_representation.edge: binary distinct source-target interaction presence within a declared study/location/time stratum
primary_interaction_representation.duplicate_rule: duplicate records of the same normalized source-target edge collapse to one for the primary representation
primary_interaction_representation.weights: not used in the primary cross-system estimator because GloBI integrates heterogeneous measurement attributes

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze source/study grouping, taxonomic rank filters, location/time strata and support thresholds; only then run projected-column support counts.
next_gate_if_parquet_transport_hold: Use the already-frozen TSV fallback only to recover the header/schema; do not inspect data rows.
